title: Dragon Quest
author: Adventure Book Team
description: A dragon sleeps on a hoard of gold deep inside the Ember Cave. Steal its egg, befriend it or flee: every road has a price, and some of them are paid in blood.

sections.text: You stand before the Ember Cave. Smoke curls out of its mouth and the ground trembles with every breath of the beast inside.

options.description: Walk in through the main entrance
Climb the cliff to find another way in

consequence.text: A loose rock gives way and tears your hand open.

sections.text: A young dragonling guards the main hall, its scales glowing like coals.

consequence.text: The dragonling burns you before it flees.

sections.text: The cliff ends on a narrow ledge. Behind a curtain of vines you find a tunnel and a small alcove.
The hall is empty now. A heavy door stands at its far end.
The great dragon sleeps on its hoard, its egg glittering between its claws. A river of lava cuts the chamber in two.

consequence.text: The dragon wakes up and its tail throws you against the wall.

options.description: Wake the dragon and talk to it
Leap across the lava to reach the biggest pile of gold

consequence.text: The heat of the lava burns you to the bone.

sections.text: You find healing herbs growing in the alcove and eat them. You feel stronger.
The dragon listens to you, amused. It gives you a scale as a token of friendship and lets you leave. You are the first human to walk out of the Ember Cave as a friend.
You land on the gold, bruised and burnt but alive, with more treasure than you can carry. The dragon sleeps on.
The dragon roars and chases you through the tunnels with the egg in your arms.

consequence.text: A burst of flames licks your back.

options.description: Give the egg back and beg for mercy

sections.text: You burst out into the daylight with the egg. The dragon stops at the cave mouth and watches you go. The egg is yours.
